commandBrief.label: UPCOMING RACE
commandBrief.title: Austin Grand Prix · October 23–25
commandBrief.text: Round 18 at Circuit of the Americas; standard weekend. FP1 Friday at 12:30 local; race Sunday at 15:00 local.

commandBrief.label: CHAMPIONSHIP
commandBrief.title: Antonelli leads Russell by 102
commandBrief.text: Antonelli 340 points, Russell 238. One title-clinching combination requires Antonelli to win, Russell P9 or lower and Hamilton P5 or lower.

commandBrief.label: DRIVER FORM
commandBrief.title: Verstappen chasing a third straight Grand Prix win
commandBrief.text: Verstappen won the last two Grands Prix at Sepang and Singapore; Red Bull is seven points behind McLaren in the constructors’ battle.

commandBrief.label: COTA ACTIVE AERO · OCT 22
commandBrief.title: Two Straight Mode zones confirmed
commandBrief.text: Formula 1 confirms 2026 Straight Mode on the Turn 11–12 back straight and Turn 20–1 pit straight. Overtake Mode is separate, with detection just after Turn 20 and activation on the pit straight. FP1 will show how cars manage deployment and braking.

commandBrief.label: AUSTIN TECHNICAL WATCH · OCT 23
commandBrief.title: Ferrari’s modest floor gain; Mercedes engine delayed
commandBrief.text: Before FP1, Ferrari drivers have tempered expectations for the new SF-26 floor: Hamilton estimated about 0.05s, not a measured result. Mercedes plans the latest W17 chassis on both cars, but its separate ADUO engine update will not debut in Austin, according to The Race. Verify installed parts and pace in practice.

commandBrief.label: FRIDAY FP1 DRIVER WATCH
commandBrief.title: Herta in Cadillac for Austin FP1
commandBrief.text: Cadillac has assigned American test driver Colton Herta to Sergio Pérez’s car for Friday FP1 at 12:30 CDT. Pérez is scheduled to return for FP2 at 16:00 CDT. Herta took his first IndyCar win at COTA in 2019.

latestClassification.message: Austin sessions have not begun; no classifications or grid are available. Latest completed Grand Prix: Singapore, Oct 11 (Verstappen, Leclerc, Antonelli).

notes: Upcoming: United States Grand Prix, October 23–25, Circuit of the Americas (round 18).
Austin local times (CDT, UTC−5): Friday FP1 12:30, FP2 16:00; Saturday FP3 12:30, qualifying 16:00; Sunday race 15:00.

At the October 23 pre-FP1 editorial cutoff, no Austin F1 sessions have been completed. Official Formula 1 forecast: Friday and Saturday 0% rain risk with highs around 29°C and possible track temperatures above 55°C; Sunday high around 28°C and 20% rain risk. Forecast subject to change.
Antonelli leads Russell 340–238 (102 points) entering Austin.

October 23 pre-FP1 technical update: Ferrari drivers describe the Austin floor/bodywork package as a modest expected performance step; Hamilton estimated roughly 0.05s, which is not verified lap-time gain. Source: https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/everything-we-learned-on-day-one-of-f1s-2026-us-gp/

October 22 reporting: Mercedes' ADUO power-unit upgrade is delayed beyond Austin; the latest W17 chassis specification is still planned for both drivers. Mexico timing unconfirmed; Brazil earliest likely per The Race. Source: https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/mercedes-rolls-back-aduo-engine-debut/
